components.purpose: Covers the entire request: the 'Features' component renders a grid of items with a Columns setting (set to 3) and a linked list of Items. Each item uses the FeatureItem model, which provides an Icon (image), Title, and Description (one-sentence) field — so the six capabilities, each with a small icon, title, and one sentence, laid out in three columns, are all handled by this single component.
